Land & Acreage

Buying and selling land in East Alabama and West Georgia

You may have a particular use in mind for a parcel without knowing whether the property supports it. Or you may own land and need help deciding how to present it for sale.

I work with clients buying and selling residential lots, vacant land and acreage within my Alabama and Georgia service markets.

Discuss a land purchase or sale

Start with what you want to do with the property

Tell me the location, approximate size you are considering and intended use. If you already have a parcel in mind, send its address, parcel identifier or listing link.

Ask property-specific questions

Before treating a parcel as a fit, identify the questions that need answers. Your list may include access, boundaries, utilities, restrictions and permitted use. Ask for the relevant records and confirmation from the appropriate professionals or authorities.

An attractive listing photograph is not confirmation that a parcel can be used the way you intend.

Selling land you own

Tell me what you know about the property and which records you have. I provide guidance on pricing, marketing and negotiations. We can discuss how to describe the parcel accurately and which information still needs to be established.

Tell April about your parcel

Buying land as part of a larger plan

If your goal is an investment, explore investment property representation. If you are comparing a land purchase with a newly built home, visit new construction.

Use areas I serve to discuss the location of your search or property.

Bring the plan, even if some details are missing

Start with your intended use and timeframe. We can identify what you need to learn before deciding how to proceed.

A question is a good place to start.

Tell me what you are considering and what you need to understand.

A little clarity

Your questions, answered

Have a question about your own situation? April answers personally.

Ask April
Does April help buy land in East Alabama?

Yes. I work with buyers interested in land, residential lots and acreage within my Alabama service markets.

Can April help sell acreage in West Georgia?

Yes. Land and acreage sales are part of my practice. Share the location and what you know about the property to begin the discussion.

How do I know whether I can build on a parcel?

Start with the exact parcel and proposed use. Ask the appropriate authorities and professionals to confirm permitted use, access and other requirements before relying on a build plan.

What should I send for a land consultation?

Send the property location or parcel identifier, a listing link if available, your intended use and timeframe. For a sale, tell me which property records you have.

Can I discuss land before choosing a parcel?

Yes. Share your preferred areas, intended use and size requirements so we can discuss the search.
